# API reference — ews-mcp 4.5

The tool table below is **generated from the registry** by
`scripts/dump_tool_table.py` (`--write` to refresh, `--check` in CI) —
the registry is the single source of truth for what exists.

## Tools

<!-- TOOL_TABLE_START (generated by scripts/dump_tool_table.py) -->
**28 tools** in the default registry (+1 with the semantic tier). Capability tiers: read ⊂ draft ⊂ full — a tool is available when the server tier is at or above its minimum.

| tool | class | min tier | what it does |
|---|---|---|---|
| `list_folders` | read | read | List mail folders as a depth-limited tree walk. |
| `search_messages` | read | read | Search mail. |
| `get_message` | read | read | Fetch one message by id (short alias from search results, e.g. |
| `get_thread` | read | read | Rebuild the conversation containing the given message id: Inbox and Sent are merged and sorted chronologically, each entry's body cleaned to its latest-reply-only text. |
| `get_attachment` | read | read | Read one attachment of a message. |
| `get_mailbox_overview` | read | read | The morning-brief workflow tool — start here. |
| `list_events` | read | read | List calendar events overlapping a time window (default: today through +7d, server timezone). |
| `get_event` | read | read | Fetch one calendar event in full by id (a short alias like 'e3' from list_events, or a raw EWS id). |
| `check_availability` | read | read | Check free/busy for one or more attendees and propose meeting slots. |
| `find_people` | read | read | Find people by name or email fragment in the GAL (global address list) and/or the personal contacts folder. |
| `get_contact` | read | read | Fetch one person in full by id — a p-alias from find_people, a raw contact id, or a plain email address. |
| `get_oof_settings` | read | read | Read the mailbox out-of-office (automatic reply) settings: state (disabled/enabled/scheduled), the scheduled window when applicable, and the |
| `get_server_status` | read | read | This server's own status: version, uptime, Exchange connection state, capability tier, send kill-switch, tool count, per-tool call counters and alias statistics. |
| `list_tasks` | read | read | List Exchange tasks (to-dos), incomplete ones by default. |
| `update_task` | write | draft | Update ONE task: mark it complete and/or set its due date ('today', '+Nd', YYYY-MM-DD). |
| `waiting_on` | read | read | Deterministic mirror query: messages YOU sent whose thread has received no inbound reply after `days` days — the 'what am I waiting on?' list. |
| `create_draft` | write | draft | Author mail as a DRAFT (never sends). |
| `update_draft` | write | draft | Update fields of an existing draft (to/cc/bcc/subject/body). |
| `delete_draft` | write | draft | Move a draft to trash (recoverable). |
| `update_messages` | write | draft | Bulk-update up to 50 messages: set_read and/or categories_add/categories_remove. |
| `move_messages` | write | draft | Move up to 50 messages to a folder (id, f:alias or path). |
| `create_event` | write | draft | Create a calendar event. |
| `update_event` | write | draft | Update event fields (subject/start/end/location/body). |
| `send_draft` | send | full | Send an existing draft (the ONLY way mail leaves this mailbox). |
| `respond_to_event` | send | full | Accept/tentative/decline a meeting — this SENDS a response to the organizer, so it is two-phase confirmed. |
| `cancel_event` | destructive | full | Cancel a meeting you organize — sends cancellations to all attendees (destructive, two-phase confirmed). |
| `delete_messages` | destructive | full | Delete up to 50 messages. |
| `set_oof` | send | full | Set out-of-office auto-replies (externally visible → send class, two-phase confirmed). |
| `find_similar` | read | read | Find messages semantically similar to a given one (vector similarity over cleaned bodies; Arabic + English). |
<!-- TOOL_TABLE_END -->

## The canonical envelope

Every list-shaped tool ships exactly:

```json
{"ok": true, "items": [...], "count": 3, "total_available": 120,
 "next_offset": 3, "source": "cache", "as_of": "2026-07-11T04:00:00+00:00"}
```

- `count` = `len(items)`; `total_available` is exact when cheap (local
  mirror `COUNT(*)`, or a refreshed folder count on unfiltered live
  listings) and `null` otherwise; `next_offset` is `null` when no further
  page exists (live paths prove it with a one-item lookahead, never a
  `count()` scan).
- `source` is `cache` (with `as_of`) or `live`; pass `fresh: true` to any
  cache-first tool to force a live read.

## Ids

All ids in outputs are short aliases: `m` message, `d` draft, `e` event,
`t` thread, `p` person, `k` task, `f` folder. Inputs accept aliases or
raw EWS ids. A stale alias returns `not_found` with a re-search hint —
ids change when items move; re-run the search for fresh ones.

## Error taxonomy

| code | HTTP | meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `validation` | 400 | bad arguments (schema-checked on the REST shim) |
| `auth_failed` | 401 | bad/missing API key, or Exchange rejected credentials |
| `tier_blocked` | 403 | tool needs a higher `EWS_CAPABILITY_TIER` |
| `kill_switch` | 403 | send-class call while `SEND_ENABLED=false` |
| `recipient_blocked` | 403 | recipient failed the allow/denylist |
| `not_found` | 404 | stale/unknown id (hint: re-search) |
| `confirm_invalid` | 409 | confirm token expired / consumed / content changed |
| `throttled` | 429 | Exchange back-off (`retry_after_s` included) |
| `rate_capped` | 429 | send rate cap reached (`retry_after_s` included) |
| `upstream_error` | 502 | Exchange failed the call |
| `upstream_unavailable` | 503 | connection cold/circuit open (`retry_after_s`) |

## Two-phase confirmation

Irreversible tools (`send_draft`, `respond_to_event`, `cancel_event`,
`set_oof`, `delete_messages` with `disposition=permanent`, event tools
when they would notify attendees) run in two phases:

1. Call WITHOUT `confirm_token` → a preview + a short-lived token.
   Nothing executes. For `send_draft` the preview shows the draft's REAL
   `to/cc/bcc/subject/body_snippet/attachment_count`, and the token is
   HMAC-bound to that content.
2. Call again with identical arguments plus `confirm_token` → executes
   once. Tokens die on any content/argument change, on TTL expiry
   (`CONFIRM_TTL_SECONDS`, default 600 s), and after one use.
   `send_draft` retries with the same `idempotency_key` replay the cached
   receipt instead of sending twice.

## Cache freshness contract

Reads served by the local mirror carry `source: "cache"` and `as_of`
(the folder's last sync watermark; delta cadence
`EWS_CACHE_SYNC_SECONDS`, default 45 s). `fresh: true` forces live.
`get_server_status.cache` exposes per-folder watermarks, row counts, DB
size and sync health. `mode: "semantic"` on `search_messages` (and the
`find_similar` tool) exist only when `EWS_SEMANTIC_INDEX` is enabled.

| `update_email` / `mark_read` / `update_messages` | `update_messages` (bulk) |

| `delete_email` / `delete_messages` | `delete_messages` (bulk) |
| `create_appointment` | `create_event` |
| `update_appointment` | `update_event` |
| `respond_to_meeting` | `respond_to_event` |

## Intentionally dropped vs v3

Removed deliberately — most belong to the calling assistant (skills), not
a data-plane server:

- **One-shot send tools** (`send_email`, `reply_email`, `forward_email`):
  the ONLY way mail leaves the mailbox is `create_draft` → `send_draft`.
- **Impersonation / delegated mailboxes** (`target_mailbox` everywhere):
  one server = one mailbox.
- **OAuth2/MSAL flows**: the target deployment is on-prem Exchange with
  auto-negotiated auth; a Graph/OAuth backend would be a different
  gateway, not a flag.
- **Contacts folder management** (create/update/delete contacts).
- **Folder management** (create/rename/delete folders).
- **MIME export** and raw-content endpoints.
- **The agent-secretary stack** (server-side classify/summarize/brief/
  voice/commitments/approval queue): the caller already IS an LLM;
  `examples/skills/exchange-assistant/` shows the skill-side pattern.
- **Inbox rules tools**: prefer real server-side Exchange rules
  (revisit after an exchangelib ≥5.2 bump).
